## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.53% | 1M: +2.95%) shows equity strength but core risk ratios VXX → flat | NEUTRAL and SPY_TLT → flat | NEUTRAL keep the signal balanced — two independent confirmations (equity gains vs neutral risk ratios).

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Gold strength GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.00% | 1M: +3.22%) and commodity reflation CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.52% | 1M: +9.25%) versus mixed energy flows BNO CORRECTION (1W: -9.95% | 1M: +8.30%).

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral: core ratios UUP → flat | NEUTRAL and Credit HYG/LQD → flat | NEUTRAL; long-duration TLT RECOVERY (1W: +0.58% | 1M: -1.44%) shows modest bond stabilization.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Tech leading: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.61% | 1M: +3.76%); Industrials XLI ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.26% | 1M: +4.72%) and Materials XLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +4.27%); defensives weak: XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -2.78% | 1M: -4.46%). Style: Growth/Momentum showing strength (XLK/XLF both positive).

5. US vs Global?  
US outperforms: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.53% | 1M: +2.95%); EM/Emerging mixed: EEM NEUTRAL (1W: +7.61% | 1M: +0.00%); China FXI CORRECTION (1W: -0.11% | 1M: +11.05%).

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Speculation alive: IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.88% | 1M: +1.21%) and IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.06% | 1M: +1.63%); VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -12.43% | 1M: -5.44%) signals lower near-term fear.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Copper-led reflation: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.52% | 1M: +9.25%) and industrial metals skew positive (PALL ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.48% | 1M: +7.87%)). Precious metals strong: GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.00% | 1M: +3.22%).

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy mixed to corrective: XLE CORRECTION (1W: -2.28% | 1M: +4.89%) and BNO CORRECTION (1W: -9.95% | 1M: +8.30%); natural gas UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -1.91% | 1M: -17.18%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: Broad equity leadership in SPY and XLK (both ABOVE TREND). DIVERGENCE: several thematic/industry ETFs (SOXX RECOVERY (1W: +14.13% | 1M: -3.80%), ARKK RECOVERY (1W: +7.93% | 1M: -6.17%), TAN RECOVERY (1W: +7.53% | 1M: -6.46%)) show 1W/1M mismatch — minor-to-moderate divergence to monitor.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor exposure to growth/momentum (XLK, QQQ, select industrials) while reducing exposure to defensives (XLU (1W: -2.78% | 1M: -4.46%) BELOW TREND) and monitoring corrective energy names.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: Technology XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.61% | 1M: +3.76%) and Industrials XLI ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.26% | 1M: +4.72%).  
BEARISH: Utilities XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -2.78% | 1M: -4.46%) and Staples XLP CORRECTION (1W: -2.32% | 1M: +0.55%).

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: Copper CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.52% | 1M: +9.25%) and precious metals GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.00% | 1M: +3.22%).  
BEARISH: Oil BNO CORRECTION (1W: -9.95% | 1M: +8.30%) and Natural Gas UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -1.91% | 1M: -17.18%).

13. Key Levels?  
VXX 20 (fear/complacency pivot), HYG/LQD 0.80 (credit health gauge), XLK/XLF 2.0 (growth vs value leadership pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive, equity gains offset by neutral risk and credit ratios. Technology and broader growth/momentum showing strength while thematic/commodity corrections and 1W/1M divergences are the primary risks to monitor.
